criteria.requirement: The landing page prominently presents a recognizable, genuinely 3D headphone product.
criteria.action: Inspect the product and its offered changing views.
criteria.expected: The primary product is a recognizable real-time 3D headphone.

criteria.requirement: The headphone presentation can be explored interactively and responds visibly to user input.
criteria.action: Use the offered product exploration and reverse it.
criteria.expected: User input visibly changes the product presentation and remains repeatable.

criteria.requirement: Bold color, modern layout and niche audiophile styling communicate the product coherently.
criteria.action: Inspect the complete landing page at desktop and phone sizes.
criteria.expected: Bold colors, modern layout and niche audiophile styling form a coherent presentation.

criteria.requirement: Product information and any offered page controls remain readable while interacting with the model; do not require checkout or audio playback.
criteria.action: Explore the model and activate any displayed page controls.
criteria.expected: Product information stays readable and displayed controls work; checkout and audio playback are not required.

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the initial headphone silhouette, depth and product-page composition.
Use the offered interaction to examine the product from another state or angle.
Reverse the interaction and inspect the rest of the landing page; do not add unrequested ecommerce requirements.

Inspect a 390px-wide viewport, including lower controls and focus navigation. Perform the task through the primary UI without relying on precise 3D camera manipulation. Record any clipped, obstructed or unreachable content.
